text:
What content-kind-0/30023 actually require, traced end-to-end:
- `crates/nmp-content/src/embed_projection/variants.rs` — `EmbedKindProjection` enum + a typed `XProjection` struct per kind.
- `crates/nmp-content/src/embed_projection/mod.rs` — the ONE `match event.kind` dispatch (`resolve_embed_projection`) that builds the projection, either calling the owning NIP crate directly (nmp-nip01, nmp-nip84) or via a `OnceLock` adapter-registration seam (nmp-nip23's `register_article_projection_adapter`, used only where a direct dep would cycle).
- `crates/nmp-content/schema/embed_sidecar.fbs` + `src/wire/embed_sidecar_fb/{encode,decode}.rs` — FlatBuffers wire union carries the projection cross-FFI; every variant needs a table + encode/decode arm. Regen is gated through `ci/regenerate-flatbuffers.sh`, not raw flatc (repo rule).
- Golden/fixture tests that exhaustively match the enum: `nmp-content/tests/embed_kind_projection_golden_{a,b}.rs`, `wire/embed_sidecar_fb/tests.rs`, `nmp-content-fixtures/src/scenarios/*.rs`.
- Every platform dispatch registry exhaustively matches the enum too: tui `nostr_kind_registry.rs`, swiftui `NostrKindRegistry.swift`, compose `NostrKindRegistry.kt`, desktop `content_view.rs` — plus the nmp-gallery preview apps (tui + desktop) that also match exhaustively.
- Only THEN do you add the new per-platform card files + `registry.*.toml` entries + `web/registry/public/registry.json` — the part #2928 describes as the whole task.

Concretely: adding kind:39000 means a new `GroupProjection` (name/about/picture/relay-hint/d-tag/parent — nmp-nip29's `projection/discovered.rs` already has these fields for the multi-event accumulator, but the embed projection here maps ONE raw event, so it's new extraction code, likely a `register_group_projection_adapter` seam since nmp-nip29 doesn't currently depend on nmp-content), wired through FlatBuffers, then 4 native renderers, then gallery previews, then registry manifests. That's ~15-20 files across nmp-content/nmp-nip29/4 platforms/nmp-gallery, not the ~5 files (one card per platform + manifest) the issue implies.
